question: Which soils are widespread in the northern plains and the river valleys and cover about 40% of the total area of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alluvial soil.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

 
• Alluvial soils are widespread soils in India mostly in Northern Plains and River valleys.
 
• These soils cover 40% of the total area of the country</span&
